The test image shows a banana plant with a bunch of green fruit. The tips of the banana fingers appear dark/blackened, and the leaves show some browning at edges. The dark necrotic tips on the fruit are the most prominent feature.

This strongly suggests **Cigar End Rot** — a disease characterized by blackening/rotting at the distal tips of banana fingers, resembling a burnt cigar end.

Let me confirm with one reference image.

The reference image confirms **Cigar End Rot**: black necrosis at the perianth/tip of banana fingers, dry and adhering — exactly matching what's visible in the test image (darkened distal tips on the green banana bunch).
